title: pilocarpus pennatifolius f. typicus
intro: Pilocarpus pennatifolius f. typicus, commonly known as Pilocarpus, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family, traditionally used in folk medicine. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Pilocarpus include its ability to act as a cholagogue, promoting bile production and secretion, and as a diuretic, increasing urine production. The bioactive constituents of Pilocarpus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
